title: lycianthes goudotii
intro: Lycianthes goudotii, commonly known as the "Chinese box thorn" or "Five-angled Lycianthes", is a plant species belonging to the family Solanaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating digestive issues, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Lycianthes goudotii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Lycianthes goudotii for medicinal purposes.
